document: ManyChat flow: Comment keyword -> deliver promised resource -> ask one qualifying question -> give a tailored next step -> optional soft offer.
ManyChat first message: Hey! Here is the resource I mentioned. I made it to help with [specific outcome]. Quick question so I can point you to the right part:
ManyChat qualification question: Which stage are you in right now: just figuring this out, trying to fix it yourself, or ready for help implementing it?
ManyChat qualification question: What is the hardest part right now: finding the right idea, explaining the value, staying consistent, or turning attention into leads?
ManyChat follow-up: Got it. Based on that, I would start with [specific small action]. It usually gives the fastest clarity before you change everything else.
ManyChat soft offer: If you want, I can also help you adapt this to your business. Reply HELP and I will send the next step.
ManyChat download flow: Thank user -> deliver link/resource -> tell them how to use it in one sentence -> ask what they are trying to improve.
Instagram comment automation pattern: Public comment CTA should be simple. DM should immediately acknowledge the comment and deliver the promised value before asking anything.
